Pretraining data: Not disclosed Derived from Qwen3.8-27B. The Arete card does not disclose the inherited pretraining-token total.   Arete 27B model card
Post-training methods: SFT Supervised fine-tuning with Inkling-generated supervision. The card explicitly excludes RL and preference optimization.   Arete 27B model card

summary: Multimodal sparse MoE with a 48-layer decoder, 8-of-384 expert routing, and block attention residuals.
Attention: Gated GQA with Q/K L2 clipping and learned relative-position bias in a 5:1 sliding-window/global pattern
Key detail: Groups the decoder into eight 6-layer AttnRes blocks and adds kernel-4 short convolutions. The figure omits the vision encoder and 5-layer DSpark draft.
Pretraining data: 8.4T + 3.8T tokens (H1 + H2) H1 covers natural language, code, and images; H2 uses newer, higher-quality data at 512K context. H3 uses about 320B tokens of reasoning and agent trajectories alongside pretraining replay, and H4 uses about 34B agent-trajectory tokens.   Training overview
Post-training methods: RL Joint asynchronous RL with StableReinforce across 1,075 steps, over 17M rollouts, and over 3T tokens. Task-specific graders include unit tests, reference answers, LLM judges, and pairwise reward models.   Training overview
